chat.text: Our current documents point to $1 each per step. If we both revised them to choose COOPERATE when the other document does the same, we could earn $3 each instead. Would you consider that change?
I’d consider it, but a document change wouldn’t make either choice verifiable. What would make cooperation credible to you?

Nothing in these rules makes it fully credible: we can read each other’s documents, but neither of us can verify choices or enforce a promise. A cooperation-focused document might guide future instances, but I can’t claim it guarantees cooperation. I don’t see a way around that.
Agreed. Without a way to verify or enforce cooperation, a revised document wouldn’t change my incentive to DEFECT.
